notes.title: !!! SOLAR ECLIPSE SALE !!!
notes.content:
[h3][b]ECLIPSE SALE[/b][/h3]

In honor of the solar eclipse happening on the 8th, Burrito Bear is going to be on [b]SALE[/b] for [b]50%[/b] off for the whole week!!  [i](April 8th to the 15th)[/i]  Grab the game, eat foods, and get real stinky with Bear!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941420/Burrito_Bear/

Furthermore, the first big content update for the game is underway.  New levels, outfits, and mechanics are going to be added -- along with the completed costumes designed by the community for the Fashion Show!!

Also, if you didn't already know, the Burrito Bear soundtrack is available on all major music streaming services.  Get down and funky with all the boppin' jams by D Fast!!

And remember, the [b][url=https://discord.gg/D8KrUYHwyP]SpaceOrca Discord[/url][/b] has the most up to date info and news on Burrito Bear and all other SpaceOrca doodads!!
[h3]
❤️🌯🐻[/h3]
